spans.s: लङ् s. the imperfect & its endings (g.).
लङ्का f. N. of the chief town in Ceylon & the island itself.

लङ्घन n. leaping, springing over (gen. or —˚),
mounting, rising to (—˚), assault, capture, conquest;
 transgression,
offence, repudiation.

लाङ्गलध्वज m. E. of Balarāma, lit. having a
plough (for an ensign).

लाङ्गलिन् m. E. of Balarāma, lit. having a plough (for an
ensign).
